# Development roadmap

Section 3 and its required compact foundations are complete; see
`docs/SECTION3_COVERAGE.md`. The project is paused for mathematical development
while the author attends to other work. Private review, statement checking,
and proof-organisation suggestions are welcome.

The planned next construction is Theorem 7.1, producing a singleton connected
component of the escaping set. This is stronger than the path-component
conclusion already formalised. The prerequisites and possible explicit
half-strip-map shortcut are in `docs/COUNTEREXAMPLE_FEASIBILITY.md`.

Neighbourhood-holomorphic Arakelyan approximation belongs in
ComplexApproximation. Reusable dynamical definitions and criteria belong in
ComplexDynamics. The specific unbounded-strip recursion and paper's final
existence theorems belong here. No further theorem is claimed merely because
it appears on this roadmap.
